nodes.name: 📖 Plain-English Workflow Guide (What It Does, Dependencies, Input & Output)

parameters.content:
## 📖 Workflow 1: Tailored 1-Page Resume Generator (Plain-English Guide)

### 🎯 What It Does
Whenever a new job is added to your Google Sheet with **`Resume Status = Create one`**, this workflow reads the Job Description (JD) and writes a **custom-tailored, strictly 1-page A4 Resume PDF** specifically for that job—without ever inventing fake skills or changing your real work history.

### 🔗 Dependencies (What It Needs to Work)
- **Google Sheets (`Job Application Tracker`)**: Reads the job row (`Job Application Sheet`) and your real skills (`Skills` tab).
- **Postgres Database**: Loads your Master Resume template, past approved examples, and your **Learned Rules**.
- **Google Gemini AI (Multi-Model Failover)**: Rewrites your Summary, Skills, and Experience bullets to match the JD keywords.
- **Gotenberg PDF Engine (`http://gotenberg:3000`)**: Converts the HTML resume into a pixel-perfect 1-page PDF.
- **Google Drive (`custom_resumes` folder)**: Stores the generated PDF.

### 📥 Input (What Goes In)
- **Trigger**: Runs every 15 minutes (`:00, :15, :30, :45`) or on-demand.
- **Data In**: Any row in `Job Application Sheet` where **`Resume Status = Create one`**, plus the Job Title, Company Name, and Job Description.

### 📤 Output (What Comes Out)
- **1-Page Resume PDF**: Uploaded to Google Drive (`custom_resumes` folder) named `<Resume_id>_Sumanto_Banerjee_<Company>.pdf`.
- **Google Sheet Update**: Paste the clickable Google Drive PDF link into Column `S` (`Resume`) and changes `Resume Status` (Col `R`) to **`Ready for Review`** so Workflow 4/5 can ask for your approval on Telegram.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO learned_rules (section_name, role_category, rule_instruction, triggered_by_comment, is_active)
SELECT
  'summary',
  'ALL',
  '80% Existing Experience / 20% JD Glimpse Rule: Always open the Summary with the grounded title "Senior Data & Business Analyst" (never copy the target job title verbatim). Anchor 80% of the Summary in a paraphrase of Sumanto''s real experience (Highspring 1M+ records & 40% overhead reduction, Concentrix 84% quality & 30% gap reduction, Maerke 25-30% client growth) and include at most 2 overlapping competency phrases (~20%) from the target JD.',
  'User rule: 80/20 experience-to-JD ratio in Summary, always start with Senior Data & Business Analyst',
  TRUE
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM learned_rules
  WHERE section_name = 'summary' AND rule_instruction ILIKE '%80% Existing Experience%' AND is_active = TRUE
);
INSERT INTO learned_rules (section_name, role_category, rule_instruction, triggered_by_comment, is_active)
SELECT
  'core_skills',
  'ALL',
  'Do NOT mention Power BI anywhere in the resume (Summary, Core Skills, or Experience) unless Power BI is explicitly present in the Master Skills tab.',
  'User rule: Remove Power BI until it is added to the Master Skill set',
  TRUE
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM learned_rules
  WHERE section_name = 'core_skills' AND rule_instruction ILIKE '%Power BI%' AND is_active = TRUE
);

INSERT INTO learned_rules (section_name, role_category, rule_instruction, triggered_by_comment, is_active)
SELECT
  'marketing_projects',
  'ALL',
  'Do NOT include the "Marketing Projects" section (Grofers 2018/2017 Mother’s Day Campaign, DIDA sportswear TVC) in the resume unless applying for Marketing Manager related roles or roles explicitly requiring TVCs, advertising, marketing campaigns, or TVC production.',
  'User rule: Omit Marketing Projects unless applying for marketing manager / TVC / advertising / marketing / TVC production roles',
  TRUE
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM learned_rules
  WHERE section_name = 'marketing_projects' AND is_active = TRUE
);

UPDATE role_few_shot_library
SET include_marketing_projects = FALSE
WHERE LOWER(role_category) NOT LIKE '%marketing%';

UPDATE resume_generations
SET marketing_projects_html = ''
WHERE position_title !~* '(marketing manager|brand manager|advertising|tvc|creative director|head of marketing|vp marketing|cmo)';

SELECT
  COALESCE(
    (SELECT row_to_json(r1) FROM (
       SELECT role_category, sample_summary_html, sample_skills_html, sample_experience_html, include_maerke_stratcomm, include_marketing_projects
       FROM role_few_shot_library
       WHERE LOWER(role_category) = LOWER('{{ $json.roleCategory }}') AND is_active = TRUE
       ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
    ) r1),
    (SELECT row_to_json(r2) FROM (
       SELECT role_category, sample_summary_html, sample_skills_html, sample_experience_html, include_maerke_stratcomm, include_marketing_projects
       FROM role_few_shot_library
       WHERE LOWER(role_category) = LOWER('{{ $json.closestBaseArchetype }}') AND is_active = TRUE
       ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
    ) r2)
  ) AS role_reference,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(l)), '[]'::json) FROM (
     SELECT section_name, rule_instruction
     FROM learned_rules
     WHERE is_active = TRUE AND UPPER(COALESCE(role_category, 'ALL')) IN ('ALL', 'GLOBAL', UPPER('{{ $json.roleCategory }}'), UPPER('{{ $json.closestBaseArchetype }}'))
     ORDER BY id ASC
  ) l) AS active_rules;

nodes.name: Postgres: INSERT Cached Sections & Drive ID (No Upsert)

parameters.query:
DELETE FROM resume_generations
WHERE resume_id = '{{ $('Compile Sections + CSS into index.html').last().json.resumeId }}'
   OR (s_no = '{{ $('Compile Sections + CSS into index.html').last().json.sNo }}' AND '{{ $('Compile Sections + CSS into index.html').last().json.sNo }}' <> '')
   OR (LOWER(TRIM(company_name)) = LOWER(TRIM($1)) AND LOWER(TRIM(position_title)) = LOWER(TRIM($2)));

INSERT INTO resume_generations (
  resume_id, s_no, job_id, company_name, position_title, role_category,
  extracted_jd_keywords, summary_html, skills_html, experience_html,
  marketing_projects_html, certifications_html, education_html, hobbies_html,
  drive_file_id, drive_web_link, resume_status
) VALUES (
  '{{ $('Compile Sections + CSS into index.html').last().json.resumeId }}',
  '{{ $('Compile Sections + CSS into index.html').last().json.sNo }}',
  '{{ $('Compile Sections + CSS into index.html').last().json.jobId }}',
  $1, $2,
  '{{ $('Compile Sections + CSS into index.html').last().json.roleCategory }}',
  $3::jsonb,
  $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9, $10,
  '{{ $json.id }}',
  '{{ $json.webViewLink }}',
  'Generated'
);
